statement: SpaceXAI plans to deploy about 420,000 Nvidia processors in November 2026 and is in talks with Microsoft about leasing further server capacity to expand its Nvidia-powered computing footprint.
why: A planned single-month deployment of this scale, plus leasing talks to add more, indicates accelerator intake continuing at a high rate rather than pausing.

impact.mechanism: Bringing a large tranche of accelerators online in one month absorbs merchant-GPU supply and draws on leased data-center space and power.

evidence.excerpt: SpaceXAI is talking with Microsoft about leasing server capacity as it races to expand its Nvidia-powered computing footprint.
aims to deploy about 420,000 Nvidia processors in November and start a $1.1 billion-a-month contract in December

confidence.basis: Single open-web outlet restating company statements of intent; deployment plans are not yet confirmed shipments.
